items.title: 82:10 · Section 2 2 states the book s
items.detail: Section 2.2 states the book's formal definition: racism is a system of oppression that weaponizes interpersonal bias, prejudice, and discrimination into structural mechanisms of exploitation and control.

items.title: 82:20 · Through formal institutionalization that system transforms private
items.detail: Through formal institutionalization, that system transforms private attitudes into a self-perpetuating apparatus that serves Elite economic interests.

items.title: 82:27 · In the book s systems vocabulary racism
items.detail: In the book's systems vocabulary, racism operates as psycho-legal social software, a fractal mind virus that runs on biological host wetware across all five tiers.

items.title: 82:37 · Section 2 2 specifies the five operational
items.detail: Section 2.2 specifies the five operational steps through which the system weaponizes individual psychology into structural extraction.

items.title: 82:44 · Step one the system institutionalizes bias and
items.detail: Step one: the system institutionalizes bias and prejudice by compiling them into formal statutes, administrative rules, credit algorithms, and policing protocols denoted P.
